project.name: OlyntheOS
project.tagline: A Debian 13.4 + KDE Plasma Linux distribution with local AI at its core.
project.vision: A privacy-first, ethically minded Linux distribution that combines a polished KDE desktop with offline local AI, a modern installer workflow, and a community-driven roadmap.
features: Concurrent Go ISO builder with Bubble Tea TUI

roadmap.description: Build the engine and assemble the crew. Lock the Debian 13.4 + KDE Plasma stack, rewrite the core ISO builder in Go, structure the Discord server/workflows/GitHub/core roles, finish the mini website, decide how local AI integrates, and finalize the age-verification policy.
Deliver a working bootable Live OS with local AI inside: package Ollama successfully, choose the default browser, polish KDE dotfiles/panel transparency, and configure a custom Calamares installer.

Turn the OS into an assistant: add a safe agentic AI runtime via Go wrappers, autosuspend models on heavy gaming or low-RAM systems, let users choose between recent models, and keep privacy and ethics as hard defaults.
Stress-test across Nvidia, AMD, and older laptops; run closed community testing; polish UX and performance; and gather feedback from Linux users about missing features and expectations.
Release the public beta ISO, ship full docs/wikis/SEO-ready website updates, publish the hardware matrix, and launch the social presence and community outreach.

status.build_notes: Installer flow is being polished and core desktop theming is under active iteration.

welcome.dm_message: Welcome to the OlyntheOS community. Please read #rules and start in #start-here.
